analysis:
Reviewed the three modified ProviderCore files. No concrete regression is visible in the supplied evidence.

1. ProviderLoop+PrefetchPublication.swift (head 25, 48, 261-265): `selfTestRecordRefuses` goes from private to internal; this widens visibility only, with no behavior change. `beginModelAdvertisementOccurrence(modelId)` is a new call at head line 48 and its implementation is not supplied. `joinsAutopilotSetWhenVerified(info)` at head 263 now auto-adds a verified build to `autopilotInventoryModels`. This happens after the existing hash, self-test-record, retirement and revision guards, and the entry guards at 41/175/223 still check `autopilotAllowsModel` and `autopilotCommand`. `models_update` still carries the hash-verified `info`. The unverified contract is whether `joinsAutopilotSetWhenVerified` honors saved consent, runtime eligibility and the failed-self-test record, and whether the inventory set is fed into any routing or advertisement path without those checks. Relevant threats: T-027, T-012, TB-002.

2. ProviderLoop+Preload.swift (head 30): the `load_model` gate changes from `autopilotAllowsModel` to `autopilotServesModel`. Whether this tightens or loosens preload admission depends on the unsupplied definition. The `model_not_selected` failure path and the later runtime-eligibility, shutdown, revision and drain guards are unchanged. `finishPreloadTask` goes from private to internal, widening visibility only, which is likely for test or autopilot use. Coordinator-driven preload is part of TB-002.

3. ProviderLoop+Serve.swift: `startAutopilotCandidateVerification()` starts at line 289. Shutdown now calls `autopilotDownloadCoordinator.shutdown` and cancels `autopilotCandidateVerification`. The shutdown ordering is plausible. The new download and verification path is new attack surface (network download of model weights, T-012/T-027). Its implementation is not in this batch, so the integration pass should confirm that downloaded artifacts are aggregate-verified and weight-hashed before advertisement, as the publication path assumes.

No change touches attestation, E2E encryption, App Attest authorization (TB-011) or the prefix cache (T-041).
